description:
Ethereum mainnet ERC-20 token balance of a holder address. Ethereum mainnet ERC-20 token balance: give token (the ERC-20 contract) and address (the holder); returns that address balance of the token, read live with balanceOf.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_chain_reads_v1/eth_erc20_balanceof. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
name: x402_chain_reads_v1__eth_erc20_balanceof
